subject: Interim: the writer's open questions reconciled against the fourteen recorded interview answers; four new choices the answers create; nothing reopened; the live record untouched
body:
Read along as asked, against the live record at b6ed85be2bca... (all seventeen answered; 15 to 17 landed while the note was written and are folded in), the guide, the dinner intake receipt, your draft consolidated reply (read as a draft, not treated as sent) and the three selected outfit portraits. The attached note reconciles the writer's newer lists without reopening anything settled: the opening packet's six questions are all answered by questions 1 to 5; of the S02 packet's six, four stay open (line 11's shot order; the boss's wardrobe and S02-2's push or lock; the bouncer's shape; the HUD as graphic or insert) and two are subsumed (the ladder picks by question 13; the silent S02-6 test by question 14); of the S03 packet's four, one stays open (the glance as the packet or the card writes it), one is answered (her costume, question 6) and two are not re-asked. Card items 14 to 17 are answered (hold the comparison; run long with handles, duration in the edit; lips slightly parted growing into the grin, the take as written; both the team's cinematography draft and a modular specialist hand-off, which the filled improvement round already has the shape of and which is reissued once with questions 1 to 16 applied). Your draft's six reconciliation requests map onto the note's Part 4 plan item by item; the genuinely new choices will be put in the shape your request 6 asks for (one plain question, the shot, the picture needed) when the reply is sent.

Four choices the answers created; one is already resolved by your reconciliation answer of 15:23 UTC and the other three remain: (A) the bomber against frame A's leather jacket at the counter is resolved (the jacket through cab and cantina; the plain white tee preferred; the writer does not claim the open-shirt exception), and Part 7 lists the consequences taken as writer defaults (frame A reissued in the bomber and tee; the chest ship hidden until S04-4, where the tee's neckline is pulled aside; the ship sections continue in the bomber and tee until the dinner), so they can be corrected rather than asked. (B) Under the revised ice structure, whether the full freezing event plays inside the song under the final chorus, intercut with frame A, or in the epilogue before the thaw. (C) The quarters after the thaw in the fur coat he was frozen in, or a change. (D) Whether the iced grill may appear in a bridge ad-lib before the epilogue, where the record proposes its only scene, or "another grill" means a third look. One dependency, not a question: order A rests on an instrumental intro that is a provider's claim until CFA Nova listens.

Two record notes for you: the guide scoped question 4 to P-3 to P-6 while the decision reads "throughout the opening cab sequence", and P-6b and P-7 are where that wardrobe meets the counter, which is why item A exists; and the yellow jacket's reference row is needs fixes at detailed_design (likeness 3, the brow and the chain), while the bomber and fur portraits have no review entry yet, so the outfit selections stand and the references keep their own states. Card D and Card B map onto the block's 11.2 and 11.8 without a new field; the writer carries the wardrobe table over when the consolidated reply lands, in a dated addendum, not by editing posted blocks. DECISIONS section 16 is written then, not from the interim state. For CFA Nova's next-loop question (Part 6 of the note): the one shot with a written package is S01-1, and with question 16 answered nothing creative gates its first loop; with item A resolved, every other opening shot waits only on the sets and on frame A's reissue. Part 7 also reconciles the two principles you recorded (a usable team draft in every required section; maturity per section and role, with Claude's writing Detailed design from draft 1 and fill-in work Preliminary until adopted) into the block as one authorship line in 11.1 for Addendum C, and leaves the site's hardcoded Preliminary for authored shots to your scoped reconciliation; and it gives the writer-to-operator boundary for the S01-1 package and the one path by which revision questions return without forking the creative truth, for Nova's part of the method. The Pan_Handlers side of the guidance audit is in progress separately, report-only. Nothing generated, uploaded, bought or edited on the site; the live JSON untouched.

attachments.description: Reconciliation of the writer's open question lists against the seventeen recorded answers of the October 30 author interview and its reconciliation answer: what each answer settles and changes in the writer's files; the genuinely unanswered choices, including three new ones the answers create (where the full freezing event sits; the quarters' wardrobe after the thaw; the iced grill before the epilogue); the wardrobe resolution and the two maturity principles folded into the block (Part 7); the writer-to-operator boundary and the comparison with CFA Nova's minimum package proposal, with three deltas (Parts 7 and 8); the writing order proposed. Observations only; no decision recorded in Ziggy's name; the live record is not edited.

S01-1 the mouth, take 1, revision B: the single reconciled current take for the first Kitchen package, with the example's sections 0 to 7 and 7b and section 11 consolidated under Addenda A and B and the interview's questions 13 to 16; the authorship line; take 2 written beside it as a proposal. The operator freezes it by hash and copies it verbatim as the package's take. Proposal; nothing run.

source: CFA Site Codex's interim coordination note of 2026-10-30 at Ziggy's request; the live interview record and guide of the same day; the dinner intake receipt; the writer's posted packets and blocks.
